status: Recovery v1: six face-down/hard and six supine/soft knockdown/get-up poses per fighter; fixed Tapper source-scale registration. No transition smears.

run.animation: Non-looping eight-pose step dash, sampled by dash age.

scale_calibration.method: Fixed standing-equivalent source scale, shared by every use of a source frame. Bent poses retain smaller silhouettes; weapons are excluded.

hook_weapon.description: Detached hooked spear. The rope is visual only; weapon never adds hurtboxes.
